title: Vacuum Energy Storage
description: Store energy in the difference between two vacua. Unlocks the Energy Cells.

puzzle.goal: Two parallel conducting plates of area A are let go at a wide gap b and allowed to drift together to a narrow gap a. Between them fewer vacuum modes fit than outside, so the vacuum pushes them together with a pressure that grows as the inverse fourth power of the gap x. Write the energy harvested as the work done by that pressure over the approach.
puzzle.name: Casimir energy extracted (integrated Casimir pressure)
puzzle.ask: The integral evaluates to π²ħc/720 · (1/a³ − 1/b³) per unit area. Find the energy stored for the plates given, in nanojoules.
puzzle.method: Work is pressure times area integrated over the distance moved. Integrate the inverse-fourth-power pressure from the narrow gap to the wide one.
